doc.title: George "Pops" Foster and Mugsy Spanier Interview, 1957-04-21

title: Pops quits whiskey; Easter picnics at Milneburg
summary: Pops explains he quit whiskey on his doctor's advice, then recalls Easter Sunday picnics at the New Orleans lakefront camps.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Dance halls, lake resorts and where bands played

Well, you talk about those days, you know. You could sit down and picture yourself in those days. They were... Easter Sunday, man. Jesus. Easter Sunday. Easter Sunday in New Orleans was bigger than New Year's. New Year's wasn't much. No kidding. Because everybody went to church pretty much on New Year's night, you know. Everybody, all gamblers and hustlers, all New Year's night they went to church. But Easter Sunday after Lent, man, there's more picnics.
